verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's DLSS docs tie DLSS Multi Frame Generation to GeForce RTX 50 Series and fifth-gen Tensor Cores, with up to five generated frames per rendered frame and a dynamic multiplier. They also document AI Super Resolution and DLAA, and say the NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features. Tom's Hardware's review confirms MFG runs on the 5090 but notes input is only sampled at the base frame rate, so a 240 FPS MFG result is not equivalent to 240 FPS native. Missing for 10: an independent or itemized game-support list beyond the vendor's 'hundreds of games' claim, and hands-on corroboration of upscaling and frame-generation quality without the latency caveat.
